stage1.impression: A moody, warm night bar with a convincing record wall, fluted counter front and timber ceiling. It still reads as CG: the counter top and stool seats are flat bright white, the floor is blotchy with puddle-like oval shadows, everything has a soft denoised haze, and nothing in the frame says EARF. The speaker is a grey drum half hidden behind glass in a niche and the room has no colour or hero. As it stands a magazine would see a generic, handsome catalogue bar, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The room's centrepiece (Mother EARF, the six-tint acrylic globe and its coloured shadow) must be in frame. At the current aim it sits about 38 deg left of the optical axis, outside the 32 mm half-angle of 29 deg.

The speaker in the back-bar niche must read at a glance as a tinted cast-acrylic horn speaker, with glowing polished edges and its silhouette clear of the pendant in front of it, not as a grey drum behind glass.
The counter top must read as zinc: mid-grey, with a soft uneven patina. Now it is near-white stone (median lum 170, delta E 15.9 against a zinc grey).
The frame's lum_median must fall into 22 to 50 (now 53.9), with the counter top and the white seats no longer the brightest surfaces in the frame.
The floor's concrete must read at 1:1 as a real board-formed or ground slab, without blotchy dark puddles and oval stool shadows that look like stains.
No denoiser smear: record spines, book edges and the timber grain must be crisp at the delivered 2400 x 1600.

defects.what: The counter top reads as white marble or plaster, not zinc: median lum 170, RGB about 187/167/151, delta E 15.9 against #8A8D8F.
The stool seats are near-white with flat CG highlights (median 141) and are the brightest objects in the foreground.
The niche speaker reads as a grey drum or gong behind glass, has no tint or edge glow, and the Dome pendant at [760, 240, 840, 285] overlaps its silhouette.
The pendant liner is clipping (0.31 %). The smoked Domes read as generic white enamel pendants.
The foreground Dome is near-white (median 225) and draws the eye ahead of the speaker.
The floor shows blotchy dark ovals (stool shadows from the narrow downlights) and stain-like patches, so it reads as wet plaster or a texture map.
The left zone is a dead, murky field (median 24) with empty chairs and no practical light: no sign of life.
The record wall is lit flat and evenly in a salmon-pink cast top to bottom, with no pools or falloff, so it reads like a showroom shelving unit.
The whole frame has a soft glow and smear (denoise and haze). Spines, book edges and beam grain are mushy at 1:1.
An unexplained bright sliver at the right edge of the counter top.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Dome pendants read as smoked acrylic rather than white enamel.
out_of_scope.why: Their tint and liner are EARF's product (fixed). Only their glow and light level may change.

out_of_scope.request: Restyle or recolour the stools (white seats read as CG).
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed in the room's design. Only their lighting (c3) is in scope.

out_of_scope.request: Move the niche speaker out from behind the pendant.
out_of_scope.why: The niches, the pendants' positions and the speakers are fixed. A camera move is the only lever.
